notFound.title: This page doesn't exist
notFound.text: The link may be wrong, or the page may have moved.

forbidden.title: You don't have access to this page
forbidden.text: Your staff role does not include this section. Ask a platform admin if you need it for your work.
forbidden.needs: This page needs one of these staff roles: {{roles}}.
forbidden.request: To get access, ask a platform admin to grant the role. Access requests from the console come later.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.text: The page could not be shown. Try again; if it keeps failing, tell the platform team the reference below.

signin.title: Staff sign-in
signin.intro: Sign in with your staff email and password, then confirm with your security key.
signin.withKey: Sign in with a security key

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.text: Enter your work email. If it belongs to an account, we send a link to set a new password.
forgot.sent: If the address belongs to an account, a link is on its way. Open it, set a new password, then sign in here again.

signin.stepUpText: This action needs a fresh confirmation with your security key. You will return to the page you were on.

errors.invalid: The email or password is not correct. If your staff account was disabled, ask a platform admin.
errors.network: The sign-in service cannot be reached. Check your connection and try again.
errors.keyFailed: This security key was not accepted. Use the key registered for your staff account.
errors.notDeviceBound: This passkey syncs across devices. Staff sign-in accepts only a key bound to one device: a security key, or this computer's built-in key (for example Windows Hello).
errors.codeWrong: The code is not correct. Check the latest email and try again.
errors.codeFormat: Enter the 6-digit code from the email.
errors.alreadyRegistered: This security key is already registered. Use another key, or start again and sign in with this one.
errors.unsupported: This browser cannot use security keys. Use a current version of Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari.

mfa.title: Confirm with your security key
mfa.text: Insert or touch your security key, or use this computer's built-in key, when the browser asks.
mfa.added: Security key added. Now confirm with it once to finish signing in.

enrol.title: Set up your security key
enrol.why: Your staff account has no security key yet. Staff sign in with a key that stays on one device: a USB or NFC security key, or this computer's built-in key. Passkeys that sync to a phone or a cloud account are not accepted.
enrol.sent: We sent a 6-digit code to your work email. Enter it, then follow the browser's prompt to create the key.
enrol.codeHint: The code is valid for 10 minutes.
enrol.noCode: No email after a minute? Start again to get a new code.

locked.title: Sign-in is paused
locked.text: Too many attempts. You can try again when the timer ends.

expired.title: This sign-in page has expired
expired.text: Sign-in pages are valid for 30 minutes. Start again; you will come back to the page you wanted.

gate.title: Use the company network
gate.text: The admin console can only be reached from the company network. Connect to it (or to the company VPN) and try again.

outcome.expired: The sign-in took too long or was opened in another tab. Sign in again.
outcome.state: The sign-in took too long or was opened in another tab. Sign in again.
outcome.issuer: Sign-in failed. Sign in again; if it keeps failing, tell the platform team.
outcome.failed: Sign-in failed. Sign in again; if it keeps failing, tell the platform team.
outcome.step_up: The sign-in did not use a security key bound to one device. Use your security key.
outcome.account: Confirm with the same staff account you are signed in with.
outcome.not_staff: This account has no staff role. Sign in with your staff account.

signedOut.idleText: For security, staff sessions end after 30 minutes without activity. Sign in again to continue where you were.
signedOut.endedText: Staff sessions end after 8 hours, when your security key is changed, or when a platform admin ends them. Sign in again to continue.
signedOut.logoutText: You signed out of the admin console. Close the browser if you share this computer.

lookup.label: Look up
lookup.soon: Lookup arrives with the user and organization screens.

account.myActions: My actions in the audit log

section.text: This section is not built yet. It arrives in stage {{stage}} of the console plan.

idle.title: Still there?
idle.text: Without activity you will be signed out in {{time}}.
idle.endText: Your 8-hour session ends in {{time}}. Finish what you are doing; you will need to sign in again.

stepUp.title: Confirm it's you
stepUp.text: This action needs a fresh confirmation with your security key. You will come back to this page and the action runs once.
stepUp.failed: The action could not be kept for after the confirmation. Try again.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.typing: Shortcuts are off while you type in a field.

reason.noteHint: Saved in the audit log with the reason. Up to {{n}} characters.
reason.noteRequired: Write a note: it is required for this action.
reason.noteTooLong: The note is too long (at most {{n}} characters).

confirm.understood: I understand, and I want to go ahead

fourEyes.title: Waiting for a second staff member
fourEyes.text: {{op}} was filed and has not taken effect. Another staff member must approve it.

problem.selfApproval: You requested this change yourself. A second staff member has to approve or reject it (four-eyes rule).
problem.invalidTransition: This is no longer possible: it expired or someone already decided it. The list has been refreshed.
problem.changed: Someone changed this record meanwhile. Reload it and try again.
problem.duplicate: The same change is already waiting for approval.
problem.purpose: Open this record from a work item first.
problem.forbidden: Your role does not allow this action.
problem.notFound: This record does not exist any more.
problem.invalid: Some values were not accepted. Check them and try again.
problem.busy: Too many requests just now. Wait a moment and try again.
problem.network: No connection to the console. Check your network and try again.
problem.other: Something went wrong. Try again; if it keeps failing, report the request ID.

outcome.accepted: Accepted. It runs in the background.

purpose.title: Open this from a work item
purpose.text: Private data is shown only for an open work item (a case, dispute, privacy request, verification or review approval). Open the record from that item.

masked.noPurpose: Open from a work item to reveal
masked.logged: Revealing is recorded in the audit log.

table.failed: The list could not be loaded.
table.viewsLocal: Views keep only filters, in this browser.

ai.label: AI assessment
ai.humanDecides: An input for your decision. AI never decides.

audit.title: Audit trail
audit.window: Entries from the last {{days}} days. Opening this view is itself recorded.

ops.review_move_to_approval_path: Review moved to the approval path

approvals.title: Pending approvals
approvals.intro: Changes that take effect only after a second staff member approves them. Check the change and its reason, then approve or reject with your own reason.
approvals.ownHint: Changes you requested yourself never appear here: someone else decides them.
approvals.notListed: This change is not in the list: it may be your own, already decided, expired, or not for your role.
approvals.pick: Choose a change from the list.
approvals.cannotDecide: Your role cannot decide this change.
approvals.approveEffect: Approving applies the change now, in your name as approver.
approvals.rejectEffect: Rejecting drops the change; the requester can file it again.
approvals.rejected: Rejected. The change will not be applied.
approvals.stepUpHint: Deciding needs a recent security-key sign-in; you may be asked to confirm with your key.

mine.title: Your requests (this tab)
mine.none: You have not requested a change in this tab.

work.title: My work
work.noQueues: Your roles have no work queues.
